result.summary: The image depicts a well-developed urban intersection featuring a high-visibility rainbow crosswalk and dedicated pedestrian signals. The presence of a buffered bike lane and wide, well-maintained sidewalks suggests a design that prioritizes multi-modal safety in a high-density mixed-use area.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the bike lane and crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features a highly visible rainbow-painted crosswalk and standard pedestrian infrastructure, including curb ramps with tactile paving and dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is a one-way urban street with sidewalks on both sides, though temporary construction barriers are present on the left sidewalk.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Narrowing
hazards.description: Temporary construction barriers on the left side narrow the available walking space for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, open lane geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection featuring a high-visibility rainbow-painted crosswalk and well-maintained sidewalks on both sides. The environment is signalized and includes street lighting and trees, though it lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions at the immediate crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of physical corner protection
hazards.description: The absence of bollards or curb extensions allows vehicles to potentially make tight turns close to the pedestrian waiting area.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner of the brick building on the left side of the image.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the turn radius.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure parking is restricted near the intersection to maintain clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
